attributes.action: Government to fund air conditioning in schools and shaded areas in playgrounds
attributes.additional_details: We call on the government to provide dedicated funding for air conditioning in classrooms and shaded areas in playgrounds, ensuring that children can learn safely and consistently without their education being disrupted by extreme weather.
attributes.background: With temperatures rising, schools are struggling to provide safe learning environments. Forcing schools to close and leaving parents having to take time off work. Many playgrounds lack adequate shade, exposing children to excessive Heat. We call on the government to provide dedicated funding

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023
